# Autonomous finite-clock supply of the literal joint-control waveform

**Current source status:** conditional analytic source accepted without mathematical repair on 2026-10-14 under `AUTONOMOUS_CLOCK_BRIDGE_ROOT_ACCEPTANCE.json` (`2392d12e1f58b03985d6b7f8ab7007dedde836de9bd816f590db5470af76e61f`). Root accepted the complete source assembly e79c1291 under AUTONOMOUS_CLOCK_BRIDGE_ASSEMBLY_ROOT_ACCEPTANCE.json SHA4d40967284c6f647fe7aba600d1ba2783423d49624eedf274589cee402e882d5 and composition review8ebc2fda20e2023faf140a8d31c597b9ed4e7f8af6963b545fe7e4e04883c54e. This publication rendering and driver await separate exact root review. Retained status belongs to the separate audit path.

For a supplied finite control waveform and the fixed finite-dimensional literal joint background, the accepted proof constructs a finite clock and a static program whose prepared isometry approximates the complete chronological evolution. The background remains present at its original physical coordinates and coefficients during every pulse, recurrence wait and smoothed tail. The free clock has a nonnegative finite spectrum. An explicitly paid extra scalar reserve can make the entire generator nonnegative, and its phase remains in the comparison.

The application to the original preparation and coherent binary-admission words uses their exact full operators and the accepted **raw fixed-background source** `7c1c3bfd1787a1041c9c58d5f7c2a7a576892ce6a554b7c9cecbc61daa74453f`. That parent now has actual canonical publication on regular OPEN PR9552 at headc57c1fed9aa585d6ec4d28607c8221f933608d8a: canonical hash8f11d1271c903212c1c85a783c6b3babe3e0036ad04c652a8756e062fc8c4ba3, with the exact raw proof unchanged. The current binding below supersedes historical pending language in the preserved source assembly and its literal footer; it does not retroactively alter that evidence.

## Mathematical inputs and their limits

| Input | Actual use |
|---|---|
| [Literal joint interface](JOINT_EVEN_MATTER_FINITE_LINK_INTERFACE_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md), canonical `212a94bb…`, complete raw body `34cbe355…` | Original L4 physical factors, operators, supplied model and preparation/readout meanings. |
| [Full finite penalty](FINITE_GAUSS_PENALTY_RECOVERY_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md), canonical `437f2f4e…`, complete raw body `bb2817d3…` | Literal full-space H, whole-term norm/incidence and scalar/sensitivity ledger. No initial-code stability theorem is used over the long control run. |
| [Neutral word](FIXED_NEUTRAL_RAY_PREPARATION_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md), canonical `e0ea48d3…`, complete raw body `0e002497…` | Exact supplied finite word, clean active input and dirty-transit return. |
| [Binary admission word](COHERENT_BINARY_K_ADMISSION_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md), canonical `25dfca56…`, complete raw body `8abf93c7…` | Coherent whole-word unitary, supplied clean work/flag, both unnormalized branches and returned transit. |
| [Existing finite Fourier-clock supplier](AUTONOMOUS_LOCAL_SUPPLIER_OF_ORIGINAL_ROTOR_RECORDS_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-09-30.md), `29602b54…` | Characteristic solution, ordinary finite Fourier compression and Dyson-prefix mechanism, with energy/precision cautions. No rotor law, collision/record theorem or geometric/resource-density theorem is imported. |
| [Published fixed-background control](LITERAL_L4_FIXED_BACKGROUND_CONTROL_BOUNDED_THEOREM_NOTE_2026-10-14.md), canonical `8f11d127…`, complete raw body `7c1c3bfd…` | Effective full-H recurrence certificate, actual finite waveform and whole elapsed duration. Actual canonical parent binding is complete. |

The publication PARENT_BINDINGS.json records six exact mathematical roles and complete extraction ranges: five complete raw proof bodies plus the complete existing supplier note, whose actual import remains its sections3–7 mechanism. The original DEPENDENCIES.json and PARENT_BODY_RANGES.json remain archived historical records. The proposed graph adds exactly one node and six direct edges, with no new roots. Generic clock credit belongs to the existing supplier; branch ancestry and other archived controllers supply no extra theorem.

The signed joint-control program is not the supplier's positive pulse program. Positivity of the free clock alone does not imply positivity of the total generator. The proof keeps the signed interaction, pays the optional total-positivity reserve, and retains the interaction term in the energy ledger. The complete scalar, actual clock spectrum, initial mean/spread, reference-complete error and whole recurrence duration T are priced. Coefficient, clock-phase and observation-time errors must meet the stated full-T budgets; finite computability is not an efficiency or laboratory-precision claim.

Data controls have one-site or ordinary-neighbor support, but each autonomous program term may touch the whole added clock register and a data pair. The supplied geometry has resource-dependent range and arity, data incidence ℓ+7c and a separate clock-site budget. A common fixed cap and ordinary-NN two-body autonomous clock realization remain unproved. Clean inputs, clock coherence/preparation, fabrication and the terminal instrument remain supplied. The comparison covers arbitrary passive references and dirty transit, with both admission branches unnormalized; it does not supply autonomous physical readout, stopping/reset, permanent records, native carriers, physical-energy identification, or a kinetic/continuum/photon law.

## Evidence and historical status

The complete 35383-byte proof below is unchanged. Its earlier provisional fixed-background wording records the status at its 13:03:46Z freeze. Fixed-background acceptance followed at 13:07:10Z and clock-source acceptance at 13:30:29Z. This wrapper reports current status without editing those historical statements. The 28 author files, 105 review files, all 30 author pins and 36 review input copies, five root-evidence files, outer execution record and current acceptance/review are preserved through a deterministic deduplicated archive. Both author pre-seal precision deltas, original failures, counterexamples and the reviewer wording history remain recoverable.

The review had pre-candidate reasoning, extensive prior same-family exposure, a complete source-exposed analytic read, and one selected exact rational multi-harmonic control distinct from the author's floating invariant-pair toy. Root separately assessed the full argument. This is not blind or model-diverse validation, a second discovery of generic clocks, or a retained audit. The assembly performs only identity, extraction, provenance and rendering checks; it evaluates zero mathematical predicates and reruns no scientific program.
